title: Export: whole-library Markdown bundle and per-post EPUB
acceptance: Whole-library export produces a Markdown bundle including tags, highlights, and source URLs
Per-post EPUB opens in Books with correct title, body, and images
Export runs off the main thread and reports progress
A library of 100 posts exports without exhausting memory
notes: A trust feature before a convenience one — an archive you can't leave is a trap.
